facts.business: Balurghat Technologies Limited operates in logistics solutions, supply-chain services, and travel-related services.
key_risks: Volatility in diesel, crude oil, toll, insurance, maintenance and other transportation costs
Intense competition and customer pressure on pricing
High working-capital requirements from delayed collections
Dependence on third-party transporters, drivers, vendors and infrastructure
Seasonality and external disruptions affecting travel-related demand
Macroeconomic or geopolitical events disrupting trade routes and fuel availability
